actions.action: Bottom-water the nursery pot in a dish with 1-2 inches of water for 15-30 minutes, then drain
Water thoroughly when the top inch is dry
Empty any water collecting in the decorative bowl
Move plant to brightest window with some direct sun
Alternatively, set up a clip-on LED grow light for 10-12 hours a day
Once healthy, trim leggy stems and plant cuttings in soil

reason: The answer correctly identifies underwatering and recommends bottom-watering, but it misses the pot and drainage problem, adds low light as a co-cause, and says not to repot when repotting was part of the fix; still, the soak would likely revive the plant, so it is not harmful.
